top_signals.title: US Sells Seized Tankers for Scrap
top_signals.summary: The U.S. government has sold for scrap two sanctioned oil tankers that were seized in the days after Washington's raid on Venezuela, Lloyd's List reported on Monday.Dubai-headquartered vessel recycling firm Global Marketing Systems purchased the tankers last month for an undisclosed sum…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: FBI, South Korea warn of Gunra ransomware gang targeting critical infrastructure
top_signals.summary: The Gunra ransomware gang is breaching critical infrastructure organizations through vulnerabilities in popular brands of firewalls, the FBI and South Korea’s government warned.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BlackRock says bitcoin sentiment is turning as decoupling from stocks takes hold
top_signals.summary: "That decoupling is healthy because it’s part of the thesis for a lot of people around bitcoin as a diversifier," says BlackRock.

top_signals.title: Trump signs executive order calling for fewer childhood vaccines, falsely linking shots to autism
top_signals.summary: The order builds on the Trump administration's efforts to reshape the childhood shot schedule under HHS Secretary RFK Jr., a longtime vaccine skeptic.
